card.name: Inside surnames like Schrödinger and Hedinger
card.fires_on: Responds to the middle or end piece of a rare proper name, mostly the piece 'inger' in surnames after a first letter or two (Schrod|inger, D|inger, Hed|inger). Weaker on 'ur' in Aburto-Oropeza and 'UR' in the brand NURTEC.

modes.label: -inger in surnames
modes.description: The ending 'inger' completes a surname in an author or credit line.
modes.example: Erwin Schrod<<inger>>: Best known for his work in physics

modes.label: Other name pieces
modes.description: A short middle piece inside a rare surname or brand name, with weaker response.
modes.example: graduate students Octavio Ab<<ur>>to-Oropeza and Gustavo

card.writes: Promoted and suppressed tokens are a mixed set of word pieces, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the tail end of unusual surnames, such as the 'inger' in Schrödinger, when the name is split into pieces.
